text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've gotten a bit better at using both 
Umastagram and UmaTok now~♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's just so much stylish stuff rollin' 
across my feed, I can't take my eyes off 
it—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is it this late already!? I gotta 
get a proper night's sleep for tomorrow! 
All right, stoppin' now... Good night, 
Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
J-Just a little bit more...! I'll go to 
bed after five more minutes, I will...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Yukino Bijin ended up staying up 
late.
